game.name: Happy Wheels
game.rules:
FPS Rules: For ILs, see the category rules, for full games, remember that a higher fps leads to a faster run. You can do it by lowering quality, particles and disabling smoothing.

Pausing: For ILs, see the category rules. For full game runs, you can get to grips with the strategy called pause buffering, which is allowed. See this guide on how to do that: [https://www.speedrun.com/hwh/guides/u32fz](https://www.speedrun.com/hwh/guides/u32fz "https://www.speedrun.com/hwh/guides/u32fz")

Timing: for ILs, do IGT. For FG runs, do RTA.  Leave the one you're not using blank.

Audio rules: Please include audio on all runs that you can, it just makes verification easier. If you'd rather not have your music or whatever captured by OBS (the recommended streaming software) you can remove it with Application Audio Capture (BETA). However, audio is required for sub 4 demo, AFL, top 3 character set runs (mobile), and all PC world record runs.

Video rules: All videos must be uploaded to YouTube, Twitch or Bilibili.

You must capture your cursor for sub 4 demo any% runs, all max% runs, AFL, but you should also for any other runs that you can.

Macros aren't allowed while running, but they are fine when resetting a run.

In the flash player, you can screen stretch vertically up to 1:1,2.  You should not stretch the screen horizontally. (doesn't apply to mobile)

After right-clicking the flash player, you must not select anything other than "Show all" (which means don't press 100% or zoom in). A lot of the audio requirements and screen stretching rules can be clarified in this news post if you are unsure [https://www.speedrun.com/hwh/news/0xrr1nxy](https://www.speedrun.com/hwh/news/0xrr1nxy "https://www.speedrun.com/hwh/news/0xrr1nxy")

categories.name: PC / iOS
categories.rules:
FPS Rules: Intentionally lowering the FPS is not allowed. If your fps dips below 20 for too long, that is grounds to have your runs rejected. For World Record runs, this floor is 25 fps.  For runs on the 60fps version of the game the ratios are the same, so it's 40 for normal runs and 50 for overall World Record runs.

Proof: Only live recordings of runs are allowed for world record runs.
Recordings of in-game replays ("view replay" right after the run) or verified TJF account replays are allowed for any run that isn't a world record. (Verify your account using this level https://totaljerkface.com/happy_wheels.tjf?level_id=10767808).

Mobile: Runners may wish to use [this iOS adblocker](https://apps.apple.com/us/app/lockdown-privacy-vpn-proxy/id1469783711).  If your game looks like it is lagging a lot, or the timer is moving oddly slowly/quickly, we will retime your run. If the final RTA time is <90% of the IGT time, or the timer is moving faster than once every second, this is grounds to have your run rejected.  All runs must be performed at 60fps.  If your device has a refresh rate higher than 60Hz, you can usually set it to 60Hz.

Playing on TJF (www.totaljerkface.com) through mobile is allowed, however, you must also have a live recording of the run, and it must not be in the top 5, or the run will be rejected.

Pausing:  Pausing during runs is grounds for your run to be rejected, however that doesn't mean a pause = rejection. If the pause is deemed to not grant an unfair advantage or to not have affected your run, it may be verified. Try to avoid pausing during WR runs as much as possible though, to avoid having a chance of your run being rejected.

categories.name: Character Set (Mobile)
categories.rules:
Complete all 15 levels assigned to a single character in happy wheels mobile.

RTA Timing:
Timing starts on the first active frame. Timing ends when you lose control of the character at the end the last level.

categories.name: Android
categories.rules:
FPS Rules: If your game looks like it is lagging a lot, or the timer is moving oddly slowly/quickly, we will check the fps your game is running at.  If the final RTA time is <90% of the IGT time, or the timer is moving faster than once every second, this is grounds to have your run rejected.  All runs must be performed at 60fps.  If your device has a refresh rate higher than 60Hz, you can usually set it to 60Hz.

Proof: Only live recordings of runs are allowed for world record runs.
For other runs, you can submit replays, but be warned that they might not be accurate when you view them. For this reason, live recordings are much safer.

Emulation Rules: A full recording of your attempt session that you got WR on is mandatory (it doesn't have to be super long, but the more footage of before and after the WR run it includes, the better)

1. Have a constant framerate of 60 (occasional dips to 59 are ok)
2. Show the framerate throughout the run (Go to the gear icon on the side toolbar > Preferences > Display FPS during gameplay (set to on)
3. The layout of Bluestacks needs to be visible (The easy way of doing this is just recording your desktop instead of a specific window)

Note: The emulator you're using needs to be Bluestacks, all other emulators are banned

Ads: You may wish to use this [adblocker](https://go.blokada.org/apk5) for individual level runs, but this is not required

categories.name: Android
categories.rules:
FPS Rules: If your game looks like it is lagging a lot, or the timer is moving oddly slowly/quickly, we will check the fps your game is running at.  If the final RTA time is <90% of the IGT time, or the timer is moving faster than once every second, this is grounds to have your run rejected.  All runs must be performed at 60fps.  If your device has a refresh rate higher than 60Hz, you can usually set it to 60Hz.

Proof: Only live recordings of runs are allowed for world record runs.
For other runs, you can submit replays, but be warned that they might not be accurate when you view them. For this reason, live recordings are much safer.

Emulation Rules: A full recording of your attempt session that you got WR on is mandatory (it doesn't have to be super long, but the more footage of before and after the WR run it includes, the better)

1. Have a constant framerate of 60 (occasional dips to 59 are ok)
2. Show the framerate throughout the run (Go to the gear icon on the side toolbar > Preferences > Display FPS during gameplay (set to on)
3. The layout of Bluestacks needs to be visible (The easy way of doing this is just recording your desktop instead of a specific window)

Note: The emulator you're using needs to be Bluestacks, all other emulators are banned

Ads: You may wish to use this [adblocker](https://go.blokada.org/apk5) for individual level runs, but this is not required

games.name: Happy Wheels
games.rules:
FPS Rules: For ILs, see the category rules, for full games, remember that a higher fps leads to a faster run. You can do it by lowering quality, particles and disabling smoothing.

Pausing: For ILs, see the category rules. For full game runs, you can get to grips with the strategy called pause buffering, which is allowed. See this guide on how to do that: [https://www.speedrun.com/hwh/guides/u32fz](https://www.speedrun.com/hwh/guides/u32fz "https://www.speedrun.com/hwh/guides/u32fz")

Timing: for ILs, do IGT. For FG runs, do RTA.  Leave the one you're not using blank.

Audio rules: Please include audio on all runs that you can, it just makes verification easier. If you'd rather not have your music or whatever captured by OBS (the recommended streaming software) you can remove it with Application Audio Capture (BETA). However, audio is required for sub 4 demo, AFL, top 3 character set runs (mobile), and all PC world record runs.

Video rules: All videos must be uploaded to YouTube, Twitch or Bilibili.

You must capture your cursor for sub 4 demo any% runs, all max% runs, AFL, but you should also for any other runs that you can.

Macros aren't allowed while running, but they are fine when resetting a run.

In the flash player, you can screen stretch vertically up to 1:1,2.  You should not stretch the screen horizontally. (doesn't apply to mobile)

After right-clicking the flash player, you must not select anything other than "Show all" (which means don't press 100% or zoom in). A lot of the audio requirements and screen stretching rules can be clarified in this news post if you are unsure [https://www.speedrun.com/hwh/news/0xrr1nxy](https://www.speedrun.com/hwh/news/0xrr1nxy "https://www.speedrun.com/hwh/news/0xrr1nxy")

values.rules:
Download the 1.87 Flash Archive: https://drive.google.com/drive/u/1/folders/1tw6Ge2Ay2c6rXwbRIhMK74jPXWjwrEbZ

Beat all levels from PLAY! button that are possible to complete. Levels with no official finish can be skipped. (Balcony Terror, Dead Space-HD, Happy Halloween and My Shotgun don't have an official finish)

Levels must be completed in the listed order for verification purposes

Emulators are not allowed.
The Standalone Flash Player is not an emulator, and can be used.

RTA timing:
Time starts of first active frame of the first level, and ends upon hitting the finish on the final level: (First frame where victory popup is visible).

values.name: Any%
values.rules:
Download Demo IGT (by Dray) here: [https://drive.google.com/file/d/1FleXQPjnC5vCJe6MRh1aVaPL33Hg1Ebc/view?usp=sharing7](https://drive.google.com/file/d/1FleXQPjnC5vCJe6MRh1aVaPL33Hg1Ebc/view?usp=sharing7 "https://drive.google.com/file/d/1FleXQPjnC5vCJe6MRh1aVaPL33Hg1Ebc/view?usp=sharing7")

Levels may be completed in any order

Any sub 4 minute run needs to have clear audio of the game recorded.

World record needs to have handcam. The handcam needs to have a clear view of the mouse and keyboard, and preferably be in a top-down view. Any WR that doesn't have a handcam or doesn't fit the handcam criteria will be rejected.  World Record runs must be livestreamed on YouTube, Twitch, or the HWSR Discord server. In all cases, the VOD of your session must be provided in your submission.

Emulators are not allowed. The standalone flash player is not an emulator and can be used

Download Demo IGT (by Dray) here: https://drive.google.com/file/d/1CxxkmjU4UzDwnBC0SLdJvJhsF6FE1I8i/view

Complete every independent finish with all available characters. Finishes which cannot be activated (SMF) are not included. Finishes which are in physical contact with each other are considered one finish, and any may be triggered to fulfill them all (Dawn, BMX).

Emulators are not allowed. The standalone flash player is not an emulator and can be used

values.rules:
For WR runs it is required that you use this adblocker: [https://go.blokada.org/apk5

1) A full recording of your attempt session that you got WR on is mandatory
